lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: You are asking me to walk out of my own campus. Two days before a vote I have been preparing for four years, with the charter on the table and the press list written.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: You lose it. I'm not guessing and I'm not being unkind. Seven to two, on Thursday, and then you spend the rest of your life saying so to people who have stopped listening.

lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: ...Then the vote is not the lever. Fine. Fine. Somebody should have told me that four years ago and it would have saved me a great deal. Let me get the slate.
